Work with our chef to create the perfect menu for your group, from casual appetizers to plated dinners. View our sample menus below or request custom options. services.name: All Cruises
services.desc: Experience Lake Tahoe’s most spectacular sightseeing adventure on our signature 3.5-hour journey to Emerald Bay. Cruise past stunning lakefront estates, explore hidden coves, and witness the beauty of Vikingsholm Castle and Fannette Island. Delicious, chef-prepared lunch available for purchase. Kick-off your evening with Tahoe’s most scenic happy hour on our relaxing 90-minute afternoon cruise. Enjoy cocktails, wines, and delicious appetizers as you cruise past iconic lakefront landmarks. Watch the mountains glow in the golden afternoon light while our crew shares fascinating stories about Lake Tahoe’s history and hidden gems.
